market_news.title: _Costco stock slips after-hours after December sales update; what investors watch next
market_news.summary: Costco Wholesale Corp shares dipped 0.7% after hours following a report of an 8.5% rise in December net sales to $29.86 billion, with comparable sales up 7.0%. Investors are closely watching these monthly sales figures to gauge post-holiday spending and the shift to online shopping, especially for value-focused retailers. Upcoming catalysts include the annual meeting on January 15 and the fiscal second-quarter earnings call on March 5, which will provide further insight into Costco's performance.

market_news.title: Why First Solar Stock Dimmed by More than 10% Today
market_news.summary: First Solar stock (NASDAQ: FSLR) dropped over 10% after Jefferies analyst Julian Dumoulin-Smith downgraded the company's rating from "buy" to "hold" and lowered its price target. The downgrade was attributed to concerns about the company's bookings, repeated guidance reductions, and limited top-down government support for alternative energy following the passage of the U.S. government's "Big, Beautiful Bill." The analyst emphasized that debookings and a less supportive regulatory environment could be lasting phenomena for the solar industry.

market_news.title: PUCO approves FirstEnergy settlement agreement providing $275M to customers for HB6 scandal
market_news.summary: The Public Utilities Commission of Ohio (PUCO) has approved a settlement agreement with FirstEnergy's Ohio electric utilities, allocating $275 million in restitution to customers. This agreement resolves state investigations into the $60 million House Bill 6 corruption scandal. The funds will be distributed to customers through billing cycles, with an additional $20 million earmarked for low-income programs and $6.6 million for improper charges.

market_news.title: Exclusive: Chevron in talks with US government for expanded Venezuela license, sources say
market_news.summary: Chevron (CVX.N) is reportedly in discussions with the U.S. government to broaden its license to operate in Venezuela. This expansion would allow Chevron to increase crude exports to its own refineries and sell to other buyers. These talks coincide with progressing negotiations between Washington and Caracas for the United States to receive up to 50 million barrels of Venezuelan oil, and President Trump's push for American oil companies to invest in Venezuela's energy sector.

market_news.summary: RBC Capital has initiated coverage on Consolidated Edison (NYSE:ED) with a Sector Perform rating and a $114.00 price target. The firm acknowledges New York's constructive regulatory environment, but its 2027-2029 EPS estimates for Consolidated Edison are 1-2% below consensus due to embedded underearning. market_news.title: Wynn Resorts to Invest USD 25 Million in Everett for New Hotels and Commuter Rail Stop
market_news.summary: Wynn Resorts plans to invest USD 25 million in Everett, Massachusetts to build two new hotels by 2028 and fund a commuter rail stop. These luxury hotels will focus on events and hospitality without casino gaming, enhancing tourism and business travel in the Greater Boston area. The development aims to improve transportation infrastructure, create economic opportunities, and strengthen Everett's position as a luxury destination.

market_news.title: Your Apple Card is moving to Chase. Here’s what stays the same
market_news.summary: Apple and Chase have announced that Chase will become the new issuer of Apple Card, with the transition expected in approximately 24 months. Apple Card users will continue to enjoy existing features like Daily Cash back, spending tools, Apple Card Family, and access to a high-yield Savings account, with Mastercard remaining the payment network. The deal involves the purchase of a portfolio estimated to bring over $20 billion of card balances to Chase, leading JPMorganChase to recognize a $2.2 billion provision for credit losses in 4Q25.

market_news.title: Goldman Sachs : Announces Agreement to Transition Apple Card Program to Chase
market_news.summary: Goldman Sachs announced an agreement to transition its Apple Card program and associated accounts to Chase, completing the narrowing of its consumer business focus. The transaction is expected to increase Goldman Sachs' fourth-quarter 2025 earnings per share by $0.46, reflecting a significant release of loan loss reserves partially offset by revenue reductions and expenses. The transition is anticipated to take approximately 24 months, during which Goldman Sachs will continue to operate the program.

market_news.title: Exxon Says Oil Skid Could Cut $1 Billion From Q4 Results
market_news.summary: Exxon Mobil Corp. announced that lower oil prices are expected to reduce its fourth-quarter results by $800 million to $1.2 billion, signaling a challenging earnings season for major oil companies. While wider fuel-making margins provided a partial offset, lower chemical margins and asset write-downs dragged down profit. This guidance comes as the international crude benchmark experienced its worst annual performance in five years and President Trump is urging U.S. oil companies to invest in Venezuela.

market_news.summary: VeriSign EVP Thomas Indelicarto sold 332 shares of VRSN stock for $79,955.56 on January 6th, reducing his stake by 1.05%. The company recently reported strong earnings, beating estimates with $419.1 million in revenue and paying a quarterly dividend of $0.77. Despite the insider sale, institutions hold a significant portion of the stock, and analysts maintain a consensus "Hold" rating with an average price target of $282.

market_news.title: SLB Advances Asset-Light Strategy with Global Land Rig Portfolio Realignment
market_news.summary: SLB is moving forward with an asset-light strategy in the global land rig market by realigning its portfolio. This involves leveraging third-party partnerships and digital tools to minimize capital tied to physical assets, improving responsiveness to customer needs, and maximizing stakeholder value. The company has integrated its Oman & Kuwait businesses into a new joint venture, divested its Pakistan land rigs, exited rig management in Brazil, and continues to operate Maverick rigs in Ecuador.

It delves into Equinix's core business, financial appeal, risks, and comparison with competitors like Digital Realty, concluding that it's a "must-have" for long-term infrastructure portfolios.

This development could impact Bunge's tax treatment, regulatory relationships, and sustainability expectations, potentially influencing its long-term investment narrative. Investors will be watching the upcoming results and the company's new Chief Sustainability Officer to understand Bunge's strategy for balancing growth with evolving environmental expectations.

The move reflects a broader concern about housing affordability and corporate ownership of residential properties.
